caption: The drawing shows a light brown or beige fabric bonnet viewed from the side, with the opening facing to the right. The bonnet is detailed with delicate lace and embroidered bands running vertically near the front edge. The lace is light in color, likely off-white, and forms a narrow, scalloped border along the edge of the bonnet opening. The body of the bonnet is gathered towards the back, giving it a rounded shape, and is tied at the bottom with two long, narrow fabric ribbons of the same color as the main fabric. The bonnet is set against a plain, off-white background. The artist's name, "E. GAUSSER," is inscribed in small, gray letters in the lower left corner of the image. There are some faint marks or discolorations visible on the background, but no other objects are present in the composition.
title: Infant's Cap
